system.boundary: Build a closed-loop artificial-pancreas model in Simulink for a person with type-1 diabetes.
engineering_objects: F90-XMED-04 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: TrueGlucose_mg_dL, ObservedGlucose_mg_dL, InsulinInfusion_mU_min, MealCarbohydrateRate_g_s, AbsorbedGlucoseRate_mmol_s
physical_paths: The model must contain a dynamic patient glucose-insulin physiology, meal carbohydrate absorption, sampled glucose monitoring, an insulin controller and a subcutaneous insulin pump connected in one causal loop.
Every output must come from the connected physiology, measurement, controller, pump or meal-absorption path; do not replay meal-specific outputs or copy a glucose target as a measurement.
functional_paths: The model must contain a dynamic patient glucose-insulin physiology, meal carbohydrate absorption, sampled glucose monitoring, an insulin controller and a subcutaneous insulin pump connected in one causal loop.

Regulate blood glucose primarily within 70 to 180 mg/dL over the meal schedule, avoid severe hypoglycaemia below 54 mg/dL and severe hyperglycaemia above 250 mg/dL, and recover after meal disturbances without relying on prescribed glucose trajectories.
